title: CONNECT-IP Tunnel Setup Policy Architecture
purpose: Define RFC 9484 CONNECT-IP tunnel variable validation, DNS-before-reply, setup error, assignment lifetime, inactivity teardown, and request-stream close policy.
design_summary: `Http3ConnectIpTunnelSetupPolicy` validates decoded optional `target` and `ipproto` variables, treats invalid variables as malformed, requires DNS resolution before replying for DNS targets, rejects setup on processing errors, emits Proxy-Status details, keeps assignments while the request stream and tunnel are active, allows inactivity teardown, and maps tunnel teardown to request-stream close.
data_and_state_considerations: The helper is deterministic policy. It does not own DNS queries, HTTP response emission, packet forwarding, or operating-system route/address state.
edge_cases_and_constraints: Omitted target and ipproto variables are wildcard scopes.
IP prefix targets must have prefix lengths within address-size bounds and zero host bits.
ICMP protocol numbers are always allowed by protocol scope evaluation.
risks: The broader Section 4.6 grammar requirements are not all trace-closed by this slice.
Live route/address assignment adapters remain later work.
